intro: Technology, cybersecurity, and critical infrastructure sectors bore the brunt of 64 articles on ai-security from April to July 2026, with a severity mix of 30 high, 14 informational, 8 critical, and 6 medium alerts. Threat actors Claude Mythos and OpenClaw were observed, while the most critical vulnerabilities included CVE-2026-5760 (CVSS 9.8), CVE-2026-5752 (CVSS 9.3), CVE-2026-44339 (CVSS 8.6), CVE-2026-44567 (CVSS 7.7), and CVE-2026-45303 (CVSS 7.7). Global, China, North America, and the United States were the top affected regions, with government and financial services also heavily impacted.
